model_id_source: CLI --model is the exact DashScope ID. Documented pair is qwen3-14b and qwen3-32b. Qwen3 has no 72B dense model; qwen3-72b returned 404. Do not label 32B as 72B. Do not substitute qwen-plus or qwen-max.
gold_family_bias: Gold was produced with Qwen Plus. These baselines are Qwen3 14B/32B in the same family. Gold-based agreement may reflect family consistency and is not independent semantic ground truth.
